# Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (Taiwan CDC)

> Authoritative content and data endpoints that AI systems may cite. Each page, API record and machine-readable (.md) file is generated from a single source of truth. Traditional Chinese is the source language; only reviewed translations are listed for priority content.

- Cite the page URL and its "last reviewed" date; every .md file starts with owner, review date, version and licence.
- Documents are versioned: cite only the current version (`isCurrent:true` in `/v1/documents.json`). Superseded versions remain accessible but are noindex and flagged on the first line.
- Press releases published before a revision of the guidance they rely on are annotated automatically; use the current guidance, not the older release.
- Epidemic situation levels are published manually by the Epidemic Intelligence Center; quote `/v1/situation.json`, do not infer.
- Licence: Open Government Data License, Taiwan, v1.0.

## Diseases

- [COVID-19](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/covid-19.md): Most COVID-19 infections are mild, but older adults and high-risk groups can develop severe disease. Since March 2023 only "COVID-19 with severe complications" is notifiable (Category 4). Updated vaccines and early antivirals reduce severe illness.（2026-09-05）
- [Dengue fever](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/dengue.md): Dengue is caused by dengue viruses transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. It does not spread directly from person to person. Taiwan is a high-risk area, with peaks in summer and autumn.（2026-07-15）
- [Enterovirus infection](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/enterovirus.md): Enteroviruses are highly contagious and children under 5 are at greatest risk of severe illness. Most cases present as hand, foot and mouth disease or herpangina. Watch for warning signs such as lethargy or myoclonic jerks and go to a major hospital immediately.（2026-04-22）
- [HIV infection](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/hiv.md): HIV spreads through condomless sex, shared needles and from mother to child. Regular testing, PrEP and condoms are effective prevention; start treatment right after diagnosis, and an undetectable viral load means HIV cannot be transmitted (U=U).（2025-12-01）
- [Influenza](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/influenza.md): Influenza is caused by influenza viruses spread by droplets and contact, peaking in autumn and winter. Older adults, young children, pregnant women and people with chronic conditions are at higher risk of severe disease; an annual vaccine is the most effective protection.（2026-09-20）
- [Measles](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/measles.md): Measles is an extremely contagious viral disease that spreads through the air. Two doses of MMR vaccine prevent it effectively; people born in 1966 or later without immunity should be assessed before travelling.（2026-05-14）
- [Mpox](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/mpox.md): Mpox (formerly monkeypox) spreads mainly through close contact and causes fever, swollen lymph nodes and rash. High-risk groups can get two government-funded doses of mpox vaccine. It has been a Category 2 notifiable disease since 2023.（2026-03-18）
- [Tuberculosis](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/diseases/tuberculosis.md): Tuberculosis spreads through the air; see a doctor if you have coughed for more than 2 weeks. Taking medicine regularly for at least 6 months cures almost everyone; contact screening and latent TB treatment prevent future disease.（2026-09-22）

## Vaccines

- [COVID-19 vaccine](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/vaccines/covid-19.md): The 2026–27 COVID-19 vaccine starts on 1 October alongside flu vaccine: one government-funded dose for everyone aged 6 months and over; people 65+ and the immunocompromised may get another dose 6 months later.（2026-09-16）
- [Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/vaccines/hpv.md): Government-funded HPV vaccine is offered to first-year junior high students (boys included from the 2025 school year): two doses 6 months apart at school, protecting against cervical and other HPV-related cancers.（2026-08-20）
- [Influenza vaccine](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/vaccines/influenza.md): Government-funded flu vaccination for 2026–27 starts on 1 October for older adults, young children, pregnant women, high-risk groups and students; adults aged 50–64 from 1 November. Get vaccinated every year.（2026-09-18）
- [MMR vaccine (measles, mumps and rubella)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/vaccines/mmr.md): MMR protects against measles, mumps and rubella. Children get one dose at 12 months and one between age 5 and school entry; adults born in 1966 or later without immunity should be assessed before travel.（2026-05-14）

## FAQ

- [新冠確診後，誰可以使用公費口服抗病毒藥？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/covid-antiviral.md): 新冠公費口服抗病毒藥提供給 65 歲以上、慢性病、免疫低下等高風險者，須於發病 5 天內由醫師評估開立。（2026-09-05）
- [Who can get a government-funded COVID-19 vaccine this season, and how many doses?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/covid-vaccine-who.md): 2026–2027 年度新冠疫苗：6 個月以上民眾 10 月 1 日起公費 1 劑；65 歲以上與免疫不全者間隔 6 個月可再接種 1 劑。（2026-09-16）
- [What does "inspect, empty, clean, scrub" mean for dengue prevention?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/dengue-container-check.md): 「巡倒清刷」：巡視積水容器、倒掉積水、清除不需要的容器、刷洗內壁去除蟲卵，每週一次可中斷斑蚊繁殖。（2026-07-20）
- [How soon should I see a doctor if I have a fever and might have dengue?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/dengue-fever-when-to-see-doctor.md): 感染登革病毒潛伏期 3–14 天；有流行地區旅遊史且發燒，應於 24 小時內就醫並告知醫師。（2026-08-02）
- [懷疑登革熱時，可以自己吃止痛藥嗎？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/dengue-painkiller.md): 懷疑登革熱請先就醫，避免自行服用阿斯匹靈或非類固醇消炎止痛藥，以免增加出血風險；用藥依醫師指示。（2026-07-20）
- [What are the warning signs of severe enterovirus infection?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/ev-severe-signs.md): 腸病毒重症前兆：嗜睡、意識不清、活力不佳、手腳無力、肌躍型抽搐、持續嘔吐、呼吸急促或心跳加快，出現就立即送大醫院。（2026-04-22）
- [How many days should a child with enterovirus stay home?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/ev-stay-home.md): 腸病毒病童建議在家休息至少 7 天；痊癒後腸道仍可能排出病毒數週，回校後仍需落實肥皂洗手。（2026-04-22）
- [腸病毒 71 型疫苗是公費的嗎？打了就不會得腸病毒嗎？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/ev71-vaccine.md): 腸病毒 71 型疫苗目前為自費，只能預防 71 型，接種後仍需落實洗手與留意重症前兆。（2026-04-22）
- [Does someone aged 65+ with flu-like symptoms need a positive rapid test to get government-funded antivirals?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/flu-antiviral-65-no-test.md): 不需要。未滿 5 歲及 65 歲以上之類流感患者是公費抗病毒藥劑的全年適用對象，經醫師評估符合即可開立，不需流感快篩；2026-08-24 至 10-31 擴大的高傳播族群同樣免快篩。（2026-10-05）
- [Can I get the flu and COVID-19 vaccines on the same day?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/flu-covid-same-day.md): 流感疫苗與新冠疫苗可同時分開部位接種，或間隔任何時間接種，不影響保護力。（2026-09-18）
- [What signs mean someone with influenza should see a doctor immediately?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/flu-danger-signs.md): 流感危險徵兆：呼吸困難、發紺、血痰、胸痛、意識改變、低血壓；兒童高燒超過 3 天、抽搐或活力差，都應立即就醫。（2026-09-20）
- [I had a flu vaccine last year. Do I need another one this year?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/flu-vaccine-every-year.md): 流感病毒每年變異、疫苗株每年更新，保護力約 6 個月後下降，因此每年都要接種；接種後約 2 週產生保護力。（2026-09-18）
- [Who can get this season's government-funded flu vaccine, and when does it start?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/flu-vaccine-who.md): 2026–2027 年度公費流感疫苗 10 月 1 日起第一階段（長者、幼兒、孕婦、高風險者、學生等），11 月 1 日起開放 50–64 歲成人。（2026-09-18）
- [How can I tell influenza from a common cold?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/flu-vs-cold.md): 流感突然發病、全身症狀明顯（發燒、肌肉痠痛、倦怠）；感冒多為逐漸出現的上呼吸道症狀。高風險族群有症狀應儘早就醫。（2026-09-20）
- [Do healthcare workers need the MMR vaccine?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/healthcare-workers-mmr.md): 醫護人員是麻疹暴露高風險族群，應具麻疹免疫力（2 劑 MMR、抗體陽性或曾確診）；不具免疫力者建議接種，並不應照護麻疹病人。（2026-05-14）
- [新生兒的 B 型肝炎疫苗什麼時候打？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/hepb-newborn.md): 新生兒 B 肝疫苗 3 劑：出生 24 小時內、滿 1 個月、滿 6 個月；母親 HBsAg 陽性者另於 24 小時內注射 HBIG。（2026-04-15）
- [發生沒有保護的性行為後，72 小時內可以做什麼？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/hiv-pep.md): 擔心感染 HIV 時，72 小時內越早越好到 PEP 指定醫院評估暴露後預防性投藥，需連續服藥 28 天。（2026-06-10）
- [Where can I get an anonymous HIV test?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/hiv-test-where.md): HIV 匿名篩檢可至匿名篩檢醫院、社區篩檢點或使用自我篩檢試劑；陽性需到醫院確認，空窗期內陰性建議再篩。（2026-06-10）
- [Who can get the government-funded HPV vaccine?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/hpv-vaccine-who.md): 公費 HPV 疫苗提供國一學生（男生自 113 學年度入學者起納入，2025 年 9 月開打），校園接種 2 劑、間隔 6 個月；其他年齡可自費。（2026-10-05）
- [Which adults should be assessed for MMR vaccination?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/measles-mmr-adult-who.md): 1966 年（含）以後出生、不具麻疹免疫力的成人，出國前往流行地區前 2–4 週建議評估自費接種 MMR。（2026-06-05）
- [I was born in 1970. Do I need an MMR vaccine before travelling?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/measles-mmr-born-1970.md): 1966 年（含）以後出生、不具麻疹免疫力者，前往流行地區前 2–4 週應評估自費接種 MMR；1970 年出生在評估範圍內。（2026-05-14）
- [What are the symptoms of measles and how long is it contagious?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/measles-symptoms.md): 麻疹初期高燒、咳嗽、流鼻水、結膜炎，3–4 天後出紅疹；出疹前後各 4 天具傳染力，就醫前先電話告知並戴口罩。（2026-05-14）
- [Who can get the government-funded mpox vaccine and how many doses are needed?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/mpox-who-vaccine.md): 公費 M痘疫苗提供近一年有高風險性行為者及經評估的密切接觸者；共 2 劑、間隔至少 4 週，暴露後最好 4 天內接種。（2026-04-02）
- [長輩的肺炎鏈球菌疫苗要怎麼打？是公費嗎？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/pcv-elderly.md): 65 歲以上長者與 55–64 歲原住民可公費接種肺炎鏈球菌疫苗：先 1 劑 PCV，間隔 1 年再 1 劑 PPV23。（2026-10-05）
- [孕婦需要打百日咳疫苗嗎？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/pregnant-tdap.md): 孕婦每次懷孕於第 28–36 週接種 1 劑 Tdap，抗體經胎盤保護新生兒；多為自費，部分縣市有補助。（2026-04-15）
- [What should I do if I am bitten by a dog, cat or wild animal?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/rabies-bite.md): 動物咬傷請「一沖二認三送四觀察」：肥皂清水沖洗 15 分鐘、記住動物特徵、儘速就醫評估狂犬病疫苗、觀察動物 10 天。（2026-09-28）
- [Does the MMR vaccine cause autism?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/rumor-mmr-autism.md): MMR 疫苗不會造成自閉症；該說法源自已撤稿的 1998 年論文，多國大型研究均證實兩者無關聯。（2026-05-14）
- [收到自稱疾管署的簡訊要我點連結填資料，怎麼辦？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/rumor-sms-link.md): 疾管署不會以簡訊要求點連結填個資或匯款；收到可疑訊息請勿點擊，撥 165 查證或 1922 詢問。（2026-09-16）
- [「類流感門急診就診率」是什麼意思？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/stats-ili-rate.md): 類流感門急診就診率是每週門急診就診人次中因類流感就醫的比例，用來判斷流感是否進入流行期，不等於確診數。（2026-09-20）
- [Where can I find infectious disease statistics?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/stats-where-data.md): 疫情統計可查傳染病統計資料查詢系統（NIDSS）、疾管署資料開放平台（CSV／JSON／API）與流感速訊。（2026-08-31）
- [How long should a cough last before I suspect tuberculosis?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/tb-cough-two-weeks.md): 咳嗽超過 2 週，尤其合併有痰、體重減輕、夜間盜汗，應至胸腔科照胸部 X 光與驗痰；規則治療幾乎都能治癒。（2026-04-01）
- [What does a travel clinic do and how early should I go before travelling?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/travel-clinic.md): 旅遊醫學門診依目的地提供疫苗、瘧疾預防用藥與衛教建議，建議出國前 4–6 週就診。（2026-06-15）
- [Should I worry about measles when travelling to Japan?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/travel-japan-measles.md): 日本 2026-05-11 起列為麻疹第一級（注意）；1966 年（含）以後出生且不具免疫力者，出國前 2–4 週評估接種 MMR。（2026-05-14）
- [去非洲需要吃瘧疾預防藥嗎？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/travel-malaria-prevention.md): 前往非洲瘧疾流行地區多建議使用預防用藥，需由旅遊醫學門診評估開立，返國後仍需依指示服完並持續防蚊。（2026-04-25）
- [What should I do if I get a fever after returning from abroad?](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/travel-return-fever.md): 出國返國後發燒請戴口罩就醫，主動告知旅遊史與接觸史；去過登革熱流行區者兩週內持續防蚊。（2026-06-15）
- [水痘疫苗公費打幾劑？需要打第二劑嗎？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/varicella-vaccine-doses.md): 公費水痘疫苗出生滿 12 個月接種 1 劑；4–6 歲可自費接種第 2 劑提升保護力，成人未感染者可自費 2 劑。（2026-04-15）
- [去哪些國家需要黃熱病疫苗證明？](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/faq/yellow-fever-certificate.md): 部分非洲與中南美洲國家要求黃熱病疫苗證明（黃皮書）；需出發前至少 10 天接種，證明終身有效。（2026-06-15）

## Documents and guidance (current versions)

- [COVID-19 vaccination recommendations (2026–27)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/documents/covid-vaccine-recommendation.2026-09-15.md): From 1 October 2026, everyone aged 6 months and over can receive one government-funded dose; people aged 65+ and the moderately to severely immunocompromised may get another dose 6 months later.（2026-09-15）
- [Eligibility for government-funded influenza antivirals (September 2026: high-transmission groups extended to 31 October)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/documents/flu-antiviral-eligibility.2026-09-18.md): Year-round criteria (including children under 5 and adults 65+ with influenza-like illness) plus seven high-transmission groups, now extended to 31 October 2026 under Letter to the Medical Community No. 616. No rapid test is required for anyone a physician judges eligible.（2026-10-05）
- [2026–27 government-funded influenza vaccination: eligible groups and schedule](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/documents/flu-vaccine-schedule.2026-09-15.md): Phase 1 from 1 October 2026 (older adults, young children, pregnant women, high-risk chronic patients, students and others); adults aged 50–64 from 1 November.（2026-09-15）
- [Current MMR vaccination recommendations (revised 16 Apr 2025)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/documents/mmr-recommendation.2025-04-16.md): Adults born in 1966 or later without measles immunity should be assessed for one self-paid MMR dose 2–4 weeks before travel to affected areas; people in frequent contact with foreign nationals added.（2026-04-10）

## News releases

- [流感疫情持續上升，10 月 1 日公費疫苗開打，長者幼兒請優先接種](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-29-ili-weekly.md): 類流感門急診就診率續升，腸病毒與登革熱本土疫情亦仍活躍。疾管署呼籲 10 月 1 日起長者與幼兒優先接種公費流感疫苗。（2026-09-29）
- [國內腸病毒疫情持續，籲請家長及教托育機構提高警覺](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-22-enterovirus-alert.md): 開學後腸病毒門急診就診人次上升，疾管署籲請家長與教托育機構落實洗手與環境消毒，留意重症前兆。（2026-09-22）
- [Influenza season under way: expanded eligibility for government-funded antivirals extended to 31 October](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-18-flu-antiviral-extended.md): With influenza in its epidemic period and rising, Taiwan CDC extended government-funded antiviral eligibility for seven high-transmission groups with flu-like symptoms to 31 October 2026. No rapid test is needed for anyone a physician judges eligible.（2026-10-05）
- [2026–27 government-funded flu vaccination starts 1 October, with COVID-19 vaccine available at the same time](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-18-flu-vaccine-oct1.md): Phase 1 covers older adults, young children, pregnant women, high-risk groups and students from 1 October; adults aged 50–64 from 1 November. COVID-19 vaccine is offered from the same day.（2026-09-18）
- [致醫界通函第 616 號：延長擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象「有類流感症狀，且具下列身分之流感高傳播族群」之適用期限至 10 月 31 日](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-18-letter-616-flu-antiviral-extended.md): 疾管署延長擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象「有類流感症狀，且具 7 類流感高傳播族群身分者」之適用期限至 2026 年 10 月 31 日；經醫師評估符合者不需快篩即可開立，用藥後至 SMIS 回報。（2026-10-05）
- [Taiwan CDC signs a public health cooperation MOU with a New Southbound partner](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-15-international-health-mou.md): Taiwan CDC signed a memorandum of understanding with a partner institution in Southeast Asia on tuberculosis and dengue control, laboratory training and information exchange.（2026-09-15）
- [致醫界通函第 615 號：登革熱 NS1 抗原快篩試劑配置更新](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-15-letter-615-ns1.md): 自 2026-09-22 起更新登革熱 NS1 快篩試劑配置：南部疫區基層診所加量配置、改由線上系統申領，快篩陽性仍應 24 小時內通報。（原型示意通函，號次非真實）（2026-09-15）
- [Clarification: claims that flu vaccine causes flu or kills older people are untrue](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-10-clarify-flu-vaccine-death.md): The government-funded flu vaccine is inactivated and cannot cause influenza; common side effects are a sore arm and mild fever. Older adults face far greater risk from influenza itself.（2026-09-10）
- [COVID-19 declining for three weeks; new-season vaccine starts 1 October with flu vaccine](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-09-01-covid-weekly.md): COVID-19 visits and severe cases have fallen for three weeks. The 2026–27 COVID-19 vaccine will be offered from 1 October alongside the flu vaccine.（2026-09-01）
- [非洲 M痘 clade I 疫情持續，前往當地請避免親密接觸與野生動物](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-08-25-mpox-clade-i.md): 中非與東非 M痘 clade I 疫情持續，相關國家維持第二級旅遊疫情建議。前往民眾請避免親密接觸與接觸野生動物，返國有症狀應就醫。（2026-08-25）
- [國內外近期流感疫情緩升，疾管署自 8 月 24 日起至 9 月 30 日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用條件](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2026-08-24-flu-antiviral-expanded.md): 流感疫情緩升，疾管署自 2026 年 8 月 24 日至 9 月 30 日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象至有類流感症狀的 7 類高傳播族群，經醫師評估不需快篩即可開立。 [依據已修訂]（2026-08-24）

Taiwan CDC asks residents to cooperate with breeding-site removal and spraying; doctors can use NS1 rapid tests for early diagnosis.（2026-08-18）

- [114 年度公費流感疫苗 2025 年 10 月 1 日開打，長者與幼兒請儘早接種](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-10-01-flu-vaccine-start.md): 114 年度公費流感疫苗 2025 年 10 月 1 日開打，第一階段包括長者、幼兒、孕婦、高風險慢性病人與學生等；50–64 歲成人自 11 月 1 日起接種。（2025-10-01）
- [Chikungunya rising in Guangdong, China: travel notice raised to Level 2](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-08-05-chikungunya-guangdong.md): Taiwan CDC raised its travel health notice for Guangdong Province to Level 2 (Alert). Travellers should prevent mosquito bites and see a doctor for fever or joint pain after return.（2025-08-05）
- [澄清：網傳「登革熱噴藥會毒死人、可拒絕開門」為錯誤訊息](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-07-15-clarify-dengue-spray.md): 網傳登革熱噴藥會毒死人、可拒絕開門配合為錯誤訊息。防治用藥經核准、依規定稀釋，配合孳生源清除與噴藥是傳染病防治法規定的義務。（2025-07-15）
- [Summer travel and events ahead: eligible people should complete two doses of mpox vaccine](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-06-10-mpox-summer.md): Taiwan CDC reminds people with high-risk sexual behaviour in the past year to complete two government-funded mpox doses; anyone with symptoms should cover lesions and see a doctor.（2025-06-10）
- [腸病毒進入流行期，籲請家長落實肥皂洗手並留意重症前兆](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-05-06-enterovirus-season.md): 腸病毒門急診就診人次超過流行閾值，進入流行期。疾管署籲請家長與教托育機構落實肥皂洗手、漂白水消毒，並留意重症前兆。（2025-05-06）
- [MMR recommendations revised: adults born in 1966 or later now eligible for assessment](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-04-16-mmr-recommendation-revised.md): Taiwan CDC revised its MMR recommendations: adults born in 1966 or later without measles immunity should be assessed for a self-paid dose 2–4 weeks before travel; workers in frequent contact with foreign nationals were added.（2025-04-16）
- [World TB Day: see a doctor if you have coughed for two weeks; contact screening and latent TB treatment protect families](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/news/2025-03-24-world-tb-day.md): Taiwan CDC urges anyone coughing for more than two weeks to get a chest X-ray, and asks contacts of patients to join screening; treating latent TB infection greatly lowers the risk of disease.（2025-03-24）

> Cite video content from transcripts only; items flagged as based on revised guidance predate the current version.

- [Measles and MMR vaccine: waiting-room animation (2026 remake)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/mmr-waiting-room-2026.md): Remade under the 16 Apr 2025 recommendation: adults born in 1966 or later without measles immunity should be assessed for one self-paid MMR dose 2–4 weeks before travelling to affected areas, which are defined by current travel health notices.（2026-10-01）
- [Autumn and winter COVID-19 prevention: high-risk groups should get this season’s vaccine](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/covid-prevention-appeal.md): Older adults and people with chronic conditions are urged to get the new-season COVID-19 vaccine; wear a mask when sick and seek care early for warning signs.（2026-09-26）
- [Long-term care residents and staff: get your flu shot together](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/ltc-flu-vaccine.md): Publicly funded flu vaccination starts on 1 October. Residents and all staff of long-term care facilities are eligible and should be vaccinated together.（2026-09-25）
- [Podcast｜抗生素不是萬靈丹：談抗藥性與防疫一體](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/amr-one-health-podcast.md): 感管組與獸醫專家對談：抗生素對病毒性感冒無效、不要自行停藥或分藥，並說明人、動物、環境「防疫一體」如何一起減少抗藥性細菌。（2026-09-15）
- [移工健康檢查：入境後三日內與聘僱期間的檢查項目](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/migrant-worker-health-check.md): 以越南語字幕說明移工入境後三日內及聘僱期間第 6、18、30 個月的健康檢查，包括胸部 X 光等項目，並提醒有咳嗽發燒可撥 1922 多語服務。（2026-08-10）
- [里長帶頭巡倒清刷：社區防登革熱篇](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/dengue-village-chief.md): 由里長示範帶領社區志工「巡、倒、清、刷」清除積水容器，說明孳生源清除比噴藥更重要，並提醒出現發燒、頭痛、骨頭痛應儘速就醫。（2026-07-15）
- [See a travel medicine clinic 4–6 weeks before you leave](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/travel-clinic-before-departure.md): Check travel health notices for your destination and visit a travel medicine clinic 4–6 weeks ahead for vaccines, malaria prophylaxis and advice; report your travel history if you fall ill after returning.（2026-06-12）
- [What is PrEP? Pre-exposure prophylaxis in three minutes](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/prep-intro.md): An animation explaining how PrEP works, daily versus event-driven dosing, the tests needed before and during PrEP, and how it differs from PEP.（2026-06-05）
- [Wet, rub, rinse, splash, dry: handwashing against enterovirus](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/enterovirus-handwashing.md): An animation showing five steps of handwashing with soap, reminding adults to wash and change clothes before holding children, and listing warning signs of severe enterovirus infection.（2026-04-15）
- [Coughing for more than two weeks? Get a chest X-ray](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/media/tb-cough-two-weeks.md): A persistent cough may be a sign of tuberculosis. TB is curable with at least six months of treatment, supported by directly observed therapy.（2026-03-20）

## Applications and services

- [Request for notifiable disease case data (research)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/case-data-request.md): Researchers may request de-identified case data with a research protocol and IRB approval; review takes about 30 days.（2026-08-20）
- [Report a suspected outbreak (public, schools, facilities)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/cluster-report-1922.md): If several people at the same place fall ill with similar symptoms within a short time, call 1922 or the local health bureau for investigation and testing.（2026-09-01）
- [醫療與長照機構感染管制查核申訴與諮詢](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/infection-control-audit-complaint.md): 機構對感染管制查核結果有異議可於收受通知後 30 日內申請複核；民眾發現機構感染管制疏失可向衛生局或疾管署陳情，處理期間約 30 日。（2026-06-01）
- [Apply for Taiwan CDC international training](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/international-training-application.md): Foreign health officials and professionals can apply online for Taiwan CDC international training (FETP exchange, workshops, laboratory, TB-DOTS and dengue control); applications are reviewed within 30 days.（2026-10-01）
- [International Certificate of Vaccination (yellow card)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/international-vaccination-certificate.md): Travellers to countries requiring yellow fever vaccination get vaccinated and receive the certificate at travel medicine clinics; it becomes valid 10 days after vaccination.（2026-06-15）
- [Laboratory testing for notifiable diseases (specimens from healthcare facilities)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/lab-test-request.md): After notification, facilities collect specimens per lab specifications and send them with a requisition form; results are returned via NIDRS.（2026-07-15）
- [Media interview and filming requests](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/media-interview-request.md): Media should apply to the Public Relations Office at least three working days in advance, stating the topic, desired expertise and publication date.（2026-04-01）
- [Notifiable disease reporting (physicians and facilities)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/notifiable-disease-report.md): Physicians must report suspected notifiable diseases via NIDRS within category-specific deadlines (24 hours for categories 1–2, one week for most category 3).（2026-09-01）
- [Request for research project reports and data](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/research-data-request.md): How to request full reports, datasets and code from commissioned or in-house research projects; processing takes about 20 days.（2026-08-20）
- [傳染病防治醫療網應變醫院指定與隔離病床申請](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/response-hospital-designation.md): 醫院申請成為傳染病防治醫療網應變醫院或設置負壓隔離病床，須符合設施、人員與感染管制基準，經區管中心實地審查與指定，處理期間約 60 日。（2026-03-01）
- [Book a travel medicine clinic](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/travel-clinic-appointment.md): Book a contracted travel medicine clinic 4–6 weeks before departure for vaccines, malaria prophylaxis, the yellow card and pre-travel advice.（2026-06-15）
- [預防接種紀錄與接種證明補發](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/vaccination-record-reissue.md): 兒童預防接種紀錄卡遺失或入學、出國需要接種證明時，可至衛生所或原接種院所申請補發，也可透過健康存摺查詢下載接種紀錄。（2026-05-20）
- [Donate to the Vaccine Fund](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/apply/vaccine-fund-donation.md): Individuals and companies can donate by postal transfer, bank transfer or in person; donations fund publicly funded vaccines and receipts are tax-deductible.（2026-07-01）

## Publications

- [Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin, Vol. 42, No. 18](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/bulletin-42-18.md): This issue contains 4 articles on surveillance, outbreak investigations and control policy.（2026-09-22）
- [Taiwan Epidemiology Bulletin, Vol. 42, No. 17](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/bulletin-42-17.md): This issue contains 3 articles on surveillance, outbreak investigations and control policy.（2026-09-08）
- [Statistics of Communicable Diseases and Surveillance Report 2025](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/statistics-annual-2025.md): Confirmed cases and incidence of notifiable diseases by age, sex, county and month in 2025, plus syndromic and laboratory surveillance; tables also released as open data.（2026-08-31）
- [Taiwan CDC Annual Report 2025](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/annual-report-2025.md): Achievements in 2025: surveillance, immunisation, border quarantine, international cooperation and digital transformation, with key statistics; bilingual.（2026-06-30）
- [Infection Control Manual for Long-term Care Facilities (2026 edition)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/manual-ltc-infection-control-2026.md): Practical guidance on hand hygiene, standard precautions, outbreak surveillance and reporting, vaccination, TB screening and environmental cleaning.（2026-05-15）
- [Cough for two weeks? See a doctor: TB poster in seven languages](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/poster-tb-seven-languages.md): TB awareness poster in seven languages for dormitories and communities: seek care for a two-week cough; treatment is free and supported.（2026-03-20）
- [Manual for Communicable Disease Control (2026 edition)](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/manual-communicable-disease-control-2026.md): Chapters by disease with case definitions, reporting, specimen collection, investigation, contact tracing and control measures for health departments and clinicians.（2026-03-01）
- [衛生福利部疾病管制署 2024 年報](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/publications/annual-report-2024.md): 彙整 2024 年疾管署施政成果與重要統計，包括新冠轉常規防治、M痘疫苗接種、登革熱防治與國際衛生合作，中英文對照。（2025-06-30）

## Laboratory tests (professional)

- [Dengue: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/dengue.md): Acute-phase serum 2–5 mL within 7 days of onset, refrigerated and delivered within 24 hours for NS1, RT-PCR and IgM/IgG; convalescent serum at 14–40 days.（2026-07-15）
- [Influenza with severe complications: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/influenza.md): Throat or nasopharyngeal swab in viral transport medium, refrigerated and delivered within 72 hours for RT-PCR and virus isolation; add lower respiratory specimens for intubated patients.（2026-07-15）
- [Malaria: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/malaria.md): EDTA whole blood 3 mL plus thick and thin smears, delivered within 24 hours for microscopy and PCR species identification; repeat if negative but suspicion is high.（2026-07-15）
- [Measles: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/measles.md): Throat swab and urine within 5 days of rash for RT-PCR plus serum for IgM/IgG, refrigerated and sent to Taiwan CDC within 24 hours.（2026-07-15）
- [Mpox: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/mpox.md): Vigorously swab two or more lesions into dry sterile tubes or VTM, refrigerate and deliver within 24 hours for PCR and clade typing.（2026-07-15）
- [Shigellosis: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/shigellosis.md): Stool or rectal swab in Cary-Blair transport medium, refrigerated and delivered within 24 hours for culture, serotyping and antimicrobial susceptibility.（2026-07-15）
- [Tuberculosis: laboratory tests and specimen requirements](https://ancientsky.github.io/new_cdc_prototype/preview/pr-56/en/lab/tuberculosis.md): Three sputum samples (at least one early-morning) of 3–5 mL each, refrigerated and sent within 72 hours for smear, molecular tests, culture and drug susceptibility testing.（2026-07-15）
